title: Operator-Norm Minimax Risk for Counterfactual Covariance Matrices under Discrete Confounding
banked_reason: Sound uniform bracket, exact diagonal rate, bounded-sparsity consistency, and matched subregimes fall below the field floor; complete all-tuple minimax frontier remains open, with a diverging directed two-cell gap and no bounded fix.
gap_reasons: The promised complete matched all-tuple minimax frontier and arbitrary-sparsity consistency equivalence remain explicitly open; the delivered bracket and matched subregimes are a weaker object, so the flagship novelty claim must be reset to that bracket or the frontier must be solved.

The delivered contribution comprises the exact diagonal rate, bounded-sparsity consistency criterion, and restricted matched matrix regimes; assembling certified proxies does not establish the requested all-tuple frontier. At the directed two-cell transition, the lower and upper bounds differ by a diverging factor b_n/log(b_n), leaving the sparse-to-dense interaction unresolved even with fixed confounder dimension.
proof_attempt_summary: Eight targeted D0 solve rounds produced a sound uniform matrix bracket, a total data-only PSD selector, the exact diagonal rate, bounded-sparsity consistency, and restricted matched regimes. Screening, signed-prior, and chaining routes did not close the diverging directed two-cell gap; the exact all-tuple frontier and arbitrary-sparsity consistency remain open. Mathematics and six cited-source attestations passed, but the achieved contribution is incremental below the field floor; formalization was not entered.
tldr: For one causal intervention covariance of an entire jointly observed bounded outcome vector, we prove a computable all-tuple squared operator-risk bracket, attained on its upper side by one total public proxy-minimizing PSD estimator. The note also gives matched growing regimes, an exact diagonal frontier, and necessary and sufficient consistency conditions for bounded sparsity. The exact all-tuple rate and arbitrary-sparsity consistency equivalence are recorded in the unresolved question \texttt{oeq:uniform-matrix-frontier}.
gap: Kim--Mishler--Zubizarreta Lemma 3.1 directly gives a spectral-norm covariance error bound with nuisance-error product terms plus \(O_{\mathbb P}(n^{-1/2})\); Appendix Lemma A.1 separately gives Frobenius convergence for a calibrated shrinkage estimator. Their fixed finite-dimensional, nuisance-rate-dependent semiparametric results do not give the growing-dimensional uniform minimax characterization requested here. Cai--Zhou gives sparse spectral minimax theory for direct observations. Uniform matrix correction with a growing unknown discrete adjustment alphabet remains the proposed gap, subject to the provisional Miao--Wang scope comparison.
fill: Derive the numerical \(r(n,d,p,s)\), its total PSD estimator, legal matching testing families, and the exact consistency region without strengthening the fixed model. The dense candidate can be corrected within this question.
